name: Bend (awbrey butte)
summary: Awbrey Butte was proposed for a fire lookout and observatory in 1919; a Deschutes County blog says no structure was built, and the summit is now fenced.
status_note: No tower was built here, according to a Deschutes County lookouts blog; the site was used for fire detection.

access.note: The summit is fenced to protect communications towers. Hiking routes follow the fence and do not reach the top (Oregon Hikers guide).

visit.trail_note: No tower to climb. The hiking route runs along the summit fence and then down through neighborhoods, mostly on sidewalks.

events.note: Forest service men at headquarters saw a blaze in private timber from the top of Awbrey Heights (Bend Bulletin item dated July 31, 1919).

Proposed as a combined observatory and fire lookout, with a 40-ft tower planned and a 50-ft tower later mentioned. The Deschutes County blog gives 1919 as the construction date but records no structures built.
